slots.hypothesis: This core is the persistent timing of when the money trades in the day (the volume centroid). Head 4 (+1.22, train and valid nearly equal) shows the alpha is in the persistent level, not the daily value. But that level loads more and more on the known family as the window grows (0.40/0.49/0.56). So the periphery stops using the level and compares the timing to other things. (1) Volume timing minus price-move timing, day_centroid(Ret) on |Ret|: money arriving after price has moved means low-impact liquidity, passive or T+1 close-buying; price moving after the money means thin late-day moves that revert. (2) Timing migration: the 10-day median minus the 50-day median, a standardized version, and a version ranked within level deciles (GKM-style shock versus level). (3) Ranking within liquidity or size deciles, which removes nonlinear size exposure (trap 3). No convex transforms, no masks, no LimitWidth or BoardCode buckets. The core was chosen over its 10- and 20-day medians because those sit at 0.40/0.49 known-family correlation against the 0.5 gate, while the bare core is at 0.19. Pre-committed verdict: if every candidate with |rho| < 0.7 to head 4 scores below 0.3, the family is only a liquidity or size proxy and is dropped in round 3. 12 seeds.

Under T+1, buying pressure means opposite things at different times of the day. Morning order imbalance is information that continues (ZWB2011). Late-session and closing-auction imbalance is T+1 liquidity buying that creates temporary pressure and reverts (LY2022, CS2004). Adding them over the whole day mixes signals of opposite sign. That is a likely reason the r1 near-misses had train near 0 and valid +1.3 to +2.3. The operators are day_signed_ratio(Ret, mul(Volume, mask)) with session masks built from in_index: morning without the opening auction, afternoon, and the last 30 minutes. The seeds take morning minus afternoon, late-session imbalance and its excess over the full day, and the gap between the time centroid of up-minute volume and of down-minute volume. Each comes as 5- or 20-day means, plus versions ranked within volatility, return or liquidity deciles. All are bounded, unitless ratios. Falsifiable: if every candidate still has train <= 0.2, the family depends on the sample period and is dropped. 12 seeds.
